blogdescription: Technology, business, faith and the occasional story. One writer, several desks.

ttm_verse.text: We wait in hope for the LORD; he is our help and our shield. In him our hearts rejoice, for we trust in his holy name. May your unfailing love be with us, LORD, even as we put our hope in you.
ttm_verse.title: Where Mercy and Hope Meet

ttm_verse_history.text: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God lives in us and his love is made complete in us. This is how we know that we live in him and he in us: He has given us of his Spirit.

ttm_verse_history.text: The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth.

ttm_verse_history.text: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of the LORD, 'He is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.'
ttm_verse_history.title: The Safety of His Shadow

ttm_verse_history.text: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.
